## Modules

- [TimelessPhoenix](https://timeless-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/TimelessPhoenix.md): Unified observability for Phoenix: persistent metrics, logs, and traces in LiveDashboard.
- [TimelessPhoenix.DefaultMetrics](https://timeless-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/TimelessPhoenix.DefaultMetrics.md): Aggregated `Telemetry.Metrics` from all observability engines.
- [TimelessPhoenix.LoggerPropagator](https://timeless-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/TimelessPhoenix.LoggerPropagator.md): Propagates OpenTelemetry trace context into Elixir Logger metadata.
- [TimelessPhoenix.Router](https://timeless-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/TimelessPhoenix.Router.md): Router macro for one-line LiveDashboard setup with all observability pages.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix timeless_phoenix.gen_demo](https://timeless-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.TimelessPhoenix.GenDemo.md): Generates a demo traffic module for observability dashboards.
- [mix timeless_phoenix.install](https://timeless-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.TimelessPhoenix.Install.md): Installs TimelessPhoenix into your application.
